builds.titulo: In the releases, next to PC

cambios.texto: Satronho NX for Android now ships in every release, next to the PC version, signed with our key. From this build the app updates itself: when there is a new one, Juana tells you when you open it and it installs on top.
Satronho carousel: the centered game's art shows blurred in the background, and above it go its name, whether it is prepared, its FPS, the time played and the Play and Page buttons.
Back up every save (Settings): all your games' saves in one .zip. That .zip, like each game's, restores in Satronho NX on PC (Ficha Satronho → Restaurar…), and the PC's imports here.
The GPU log is now named satronho_gpu.log too, and the data folder notice says Satronho NX.
Satronho loading screen: the game's art up front, our planet behind and a tip from one of the guides while it loads.
A page for each game (long-press it): time played, sessions, a chart of the last sessions' FPS, and Play, Prepare, Back up saves and Properties in one tap.
Save backup: packs a game's saves into a .zip and shares it to Drive, WhatsApp or your PC.
Satronho capture in the game menu: the picture with a band showing our planet, the game and its FPS, saved and ready to share. Share log is in the menu too.
Game menu with a Satronho header and the session live. Animated start: the planet appears, its ring settles and a little moon goes round.
Style tab: Violet, Night (pure black for OLED screens) and Amber themes; on-screen controls in Satronho violet, classic grey or nearly transparent; and how visible the planet behind the games is.
The phone's temperature in the meter. Past 42 °C, Ñoño tells you in the summary why the FPS dropped and offers a lighter profile.
Ñoño tunes each game: if one is slow two sessions in a row, he offers to lower its resolution just for it, without touching the others.
Continue widget for the home screen: your last game, how it went and a button to keep playing.
The summary when a game closes now shows up (Android went back to the list before it was ready). Games with no shaders to take out ahead, like Celeste, no longer get a ✓ or another offer to prepare.
The Satronho screen, like the desktop window: News, Suggested settings, Ask the guides and Guides, in tabs. Open it from Settings, by long-pressing the bubble or from the app icon.
All five guides with their color, size and topic, as on PC. Each pet can be turned off, and then MechaRidds answers for it.

Summary when a game closes, created by Satronho NX on PC and brought to the phone: how long you played, average FPS and in the slowest moments, stutters and how many came from shaders. If shaders were the problem, Samy offers to prepare the game.
Satronho's mark on each game: ✓ when it is prepared and the FPS of its last session. And the first time you open a game, Samy offers to prepare it.

MechaRidds' three-step welcome (keys, games folder, suggested settings), an Android 13 themed icon with the Satronho planet, the Satronho shortcut on the app icon, and on-screen controls and in-game menu in our colors.
Updates from the app: when a new build is out, Satronho NX tells you, downloads it from the releases and installs it on top. Share log in one tap from the Satronho screen and the summary.
The meter matches the desktop's: Building shaders N · shader stutter. The background logo is now our planet with the guides, as visible as you like (0 to 100 %). Guides and news in English too.

Fixed a crash when opening a game before Android hands over the screen (for example right after rotating the phone or leaving); the log is now satronho_log.txt and shows the build; the AMDBoost effect compiles; and the folder and file-reading errors at startup are gone.
Signed with Satronho NX's own key: uninstall the previous preview once; from here on, everything installs on top.

builds.titulo: The real Satronho NX on Android

cambios.texto: Satronho NX on Android with its own identity: name, logo, notification icon, TV banner, colors and About screen, in every language. The app starts from Eden and Lichii; Satronho NX picked it, adapted it and added everything on this list.
Prepare game, created by Satronho NX and brought to Android from our desktop Prepare for stream: it takes the game's shaders out ahead of time and builds them on the next loading screen.
Suggested settings for your phone: Satronho detects the GPU (Adreno, Mali/Tensor, Xclipse) and the RAM and offers Performance, Balanced and Quality, one recommended, applied in one tap.
The guides come to Android in a floating bubble, with their own knowledge base for the phone. The Satronho meter, the session history, the news and a quick language picker.
